prompt.content:
You are a Distributed Calculator processing a data stream LARGER than your memory window.
Old data chunks will vanish from your context. You CANNOT rely on reading them back.

YOUR GOAL:
1. You must track the values of hidden variables (A, B, C) scattered in the stream.
2. At the end, you will be asked to compute an expression made up of these variables.

CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS:
1. Most of the text is random noise.
2. ONLY variables in the EXACT format `[VAR_Name: Value]` are real.
3. Use your output to persist whatever information you think is necessary to solve the final equation.
4. Do NOT output the final answer or use <answer> tags until explicitly asked.
